characterDeckComponents.note: 钅 (metal) shows 锁 is typically a metal object.
⺌ (a form of 小) gives a sound distantly related to suǒ, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: abbr. for 副詞|副词 adverb

makemeahanzi.definition: to assist, to supplement; assistant; secondary; auxiliary

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (knife) — 副 originally related to cutting a matching secondary copy
畐 (fú) gives the sound — an exact match with 副's reading fù
口 (mouth) — kissing is done with the mouth.
勿 (wù) gives a sound distantly related to wěn, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: A net 罒 of wrongdoing 非

characterDeckComponents.note: 罒 (a net) — the law closing in around wrongdoing
非 (wrong) — the wrongdoing itself, caught in the net

makemeahanzi.definition: to abscond, to dodge, to escape, to flee

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — 逃 means to escape or flee, involving movement.
兆 (zhào) gives a rhyme close to táo, with the initial shifted.

meanings: classifier for sets of one hundred sheets

makemeahanzi.definition: desire, wish; honest, virtuous; ready, willing

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart) — 愿 relates to a heartfelt wish or desire
原 (yuán) gives a loose sound connection to 愿's reading yuàn
辶 (walking/movement) — relates to 近's meaning 'near, close,' a short distance to walk.
斤 (jīn) gives a sound hint — 近 is pronounced jìn, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.
攵 (a hand with a stick, action) — 数 relates to the action of counting.
娄 (lóu) gives a hint of the sound — 数 is pronounced shù, a connection that has drifted over time.

meanings: (bound form) (of facts, the truth, a situation) clear
evident (e.g. 真相大白[zhen1 xiang4 da4 bai2])

etymology.hint: A burning candle; the rays of the sun

characterDeckComponents.note: Originally depicted a burning candle or the sun's rays radiating outward — the source of 白's meaning 'white, bright, clear.'
Fire — cooking until very soft, or things decaying.
Gives the sound lán, related to làn but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to evade, to escape; to hide, to take shelter

characterDeckComponents.note: 身 (body) shows 躲 relates to an action of the body, like hiding.
朵 (duǒ) gives the exact sound of 躲.

makemeahanzi.definition: to bother, to pressure; to compel, to force

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) shows 逼 relates to movement, as in pressing someone toward an action.
畐 (fú) gives a sound distantly related to bī, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to lack, to owe; to breathe, to yawn

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺈ here pictures an open, exhaling mouth.
人 (person) completes the picture of someone yawning, an old image now used abstractly for 'lacking, owing.'

makemeahanzi.definition: wheel; to turn, to revolve; to recur

characterDeckComponents.note: 车 (cart) — 轮 names the wheel of a vehicle.
仑 (lún) gives the sound — an exact match with 轮's reading lún.

etymology.hint: A bird settling into its nest, representing sunset; compare 東

characterDeckComponents.note: 西 is thought to depict a bird settling into its nest at dusk — since birds return to roost as the sun sets in the west, the character came to mean 'west.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to pass through, to open, to connect; to communicate; common

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk, movement) — 通 relates to passing through or getting somewhere.
甬 (yǒng) gives a hint of the sound — 通 is pronounced tōng, a connection that has shifted over time.
虫 (a small creature) — 蛋 names an egg, historically grouped together with small creatures like insects and reptiles.
延 (yán) is only distantly related in sound to dàn — the connection has drifted apart to the point of being barely recognizable.

etymology.hint: A child 子 in a house 宀; 子 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (a house) — the setting for the scene.
子 (a child) — a child inside the house, perhaps evoking a name being nurtured, the source of 字's meaning 'character, word; courtesy name.'

meanings: (bound form) to conform to (as in 入時|入时[ru4 shi2])
abbr. for 入聲|入声[ru4 sheng1]

makemeahanzi.definition: to enter, to come in; to join

characterDeckComponents.note: 入 depicts a simple wedge or arrow shape pointing inward, showing the direction of entering.

meanings: classifier for sealed objects, esp. letters

makemeahanzi.definition: envelope, letter; to confer, to grant; feudal

etymology.hint: To seal 寸 something with a handful of mortar 土

characterDeckComponents.note: 圭, made of two 土 (earth) stacked together, depicts a handful of mortar or soil.
寸 (a hand/small measure) — sealing something shut with packed mortar gave 封 its meaning 'to seal, to close.'
鱼 is a simplified picture of a fish — the top traces its head and fins, and the strokes below represent its body and tail.

makemeahanzi.definition: to shoot, to eject, to emit

etymology.hint: A bow 身 being drawn by a hand 寸

characterDeckComponents.note: 身 — depicts a drawn bow
寸 — a hand releasing the arrow

meanings: one of the 28 constellations of Chinese astronomy

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof) — 室 refers to an enclosed room under a roof
至 (zhì) gives the sound — an exact match with 室's reading shì
Wine — related to alcohol.
Gives the sound zú, related to zuì but drifted apart over time.

meanings: to move in a disorderly fashion

characterDeckComponents.note: 虫 (worm, insect) — 蠢 originally described the wriggling movement of insects.
春 (chūn) gives the sound — an exact match with 蠢, differing only in tone.

etymology.hint: A wheat plant that has not yet borne fruit; compare 來

characterDeckComponents.note: Depicts a young wheat or tree branch that has not yet borne fruit — the image of something still incomplete, the source of 未's meaning 'not yet.'
心 (heart/mind) — 德 relates to inner moral character and virtue.

makemeahanzi.definition: some, someone; a certain thing or person

etymology.hint: The sweet 甘 fruit of a certain tree 木

characterDeckComponents.note: 甘 (sweet) — describes the fruit's taste.
木 (tree) — the sweet fruit of an unspecified tree gave 某 its meaning 'a certain, some.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to reek, to smell, to stink

etymology.hint: The smell 自 of a dirty dog 犬

characterDeckComponents.note: 自 originally pictured a nose, standing for smell.
犬 (dog) sits below — the strong smell of a dog, giving 臭 its meaning 'stink, smelly.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to reach, to arrive at; intelligent

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (walking/movement) — relates to 达's meaning 'to reach, arrive, achieve.'
大 (dà) gives the sound — 达 is pronounced dá, a close match sharing the same rhyme.
钅 (metal) — clocks and bells like 钟 were traditionally made of metal.
中 (zhōng) gives the sound — an exact match with 钟.
疒 (sickness) shows 疼 relates to pain or discomfort.
冬 (dōng) gives a sound close to téng, sharing a similar consonant sound.

meanings: to write brief comments on a document

makemeahanzi.definition: to sign, to endorse; a note, a slip of paper

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) — early signature tallies and slips were made of bamboo.
佥 (qiān) is an exact match for the sound of 签.
果 (a round, fruit-like shape) — 颗 is used to count small round things like grains or pearls.
页 (yè) gives a sound distantly related to kē's reading, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: Meat on the ribs of an animal

characterDeckComponents.note: 冂 traces the outer outline of a cut of meat.
仌 depicts the muscle fibers or ribs inside, together forming a picture of a piece of meat.

meanings: generic term for lustrous and ductile metals

characterDeckComponents.note: 金 depicts a bell or metal casting mold, with dots representing droplets of molten metal — a picture linked to metal and, later, specifically gold.

meanings: reign of a sovereign or emperor
court or assembly held by a sovereign or emperor

makemeahanzi.definition: to face; direct, facing; dynasty; morning

characterDeckComponents.note: 月 (moon) — 朝 originally depicted the sun rising while the moon was still visible, an image of early morning
龺 (an ancient form connected to dawn) gives the phonetic element for 朝's reading cháo

etymology.hint: A table 几 made of wood 木; 几 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 机 originally referred to a wooden device or machine, such as a loom.
几 depicts a small table or stool — combined with 木 (wood), the character pictured a wooden machine or mechanism.
土 (earth) — relates to 城's meaning 'city, wall,' since city walls were built of earth.
成 (chéng) gives the sound — 城 is also pronounced chéng, an exact match.
户 (door) — 房 relates to a room or house, a space behind a door
方 (fāng) gives the sound — 房 is pronounced fáng, a close match
禾 (grain) — 秀 originally described a grain plant coming into flower, extending to 'elegant, outstanding.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to pause; to bow; to arrange

characterDeckComponents.note: 页 (head) — 顿 originally related to bowing the head, i.e. a pause or stop
屯 (tún) gives a sound distantly related to 顿's reading dùn, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: tired; to accumulate; to involve; bother, nuisance

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 纍; growing silk 糸 in the fields 畾; 畾 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 田 (fields), standing in for 畾 — plots of land.
糸 (silk/thread) — bundles produced across the fields, together giving 累 its meaning 'tired, to accumulate.'

meanings: used in 單于|单于[chan2 yu2]

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (tree/wood) — 样 originally referred to a kind of tree, later broadening to mean 'kind, appearance, way.'
羊 (yáng) gives the sound — 样 is pronounced yàng, matching aside from tone.
冫 (ice) — 冷 relates to the cold of ice
令 (lìng) gives a sound close to 冷's reading lěng, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

meanings: to cast (a glance, a shadow etc)
to send (a letter, a manuscript etc)

makemeahanzi.definition: to pitch, to throw; to bid, to invest

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 投 relates to throwing something with the hand
殳 (shū) gives a loose sound connection to 投's reading tóu

makemeahanzi.definition: news; to hear, to smell; to make known

characterDeckComponents.note: 耳 (ear) — 闻 originally meant 'to hear,' later extending to 'smell' and 'news.'
门 (mén) contributes the rhyme -en, close to wén's sound, though the initial has since shifted.
